label: Muscular System
alt: Full available Z-Anatomy muscular system over the bilateral skeleton. Ivory tendon regions remain part of their parent muscle. Use fascia, tendon, sheath, and bursa layers for context. Select a muscle to reveal source-model attachment surfaces.
reviewNote: Attachment placement is provisional. Ivory = tendon regions; fascia is translucent. Select a muscle for origin (red) and insertion (blue) surfaces. 30 unmatched attachment surfaces remain hidden.

structureGroups.label: Tendons & bands (36)
structureGroups.description: Separate tendon structures, retinacula, and connective bands. Tendon regions within muscles stay with their parent muscle.

structureGroups.label: Fascia & aponeuroses (63)
structureGroups.description: Show the source fascia and aponeuroses at 30% opacity.
